_about: Defaults of the relief tool. Project-specific values go into config/project.json; any value can also be set on the command line (--set section.key=value). Keys starting with '_' are notes.

paths._output_dir: where the results go, relative to the folder the command is run from (or a full path)
paths._work_dir: cache of intermediate results (safe to delete); null = %LOCALAPPDATA%/ing_studio_toolkit/pointcloud_to_archicad_relief
paths._source_cloud: point cloud used when only a .pln is given (file or list of files)

tools._note: null = found automatically (QGIS for PDAL, standard install folders)

cloud._clip_source: [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax] in point cloud coordinates, or null for the whole cloud

placement._mode: auto: fit to the point cloud object in the PLN made from this cloud, else the cloud's own coordinates + offset/rotation | object | coordinates
placement._source_z: coordinates mode: sea_level (Z = m a.s.l.) | project_zero | auto
placement._new_pln_origin: PLN made from the point cloud alone: auto = the project origin is moved near the cloud (rounded to 100 m) when the cloud is more than 1 km from 0,0, as Archicad is inaccurate far from its origin | keep = the cloud's own coordinates | [x, y] = this cloud point becomes the origin

mesh._note: ONE terrain mesh: adaptive points of the clean DEM inside one outline. The smallest vertical tolerance between min_tolerance_m and max_tolerance_m that stays within target_points is used.

contours._note: the mesh is cut by horizontal planes on whole metres above sea level; one layer per cut size, each layer complete on its own

smoothing._note: every cut line: Reduce -> cull short lines -> NURBS through the vertices as control points -> Simplify

archicad._note: <name>_ReliefOnly.pln starts as a copy of the Archicad template. Elements on layers named '<layer_prefix>*' are replaced on every write. Any unexpected Archicad dialog stops the pipeline without saving.
archicad._pens: contour pens, finest cut size first; the last one is used for any further sizes
archicad._contours_3d: Splines are 2D; with contours_3d every line is also written as a thin upright Morph ribbon on the same layer, so each size can be shown or hidden in 3D. Ribbon height, and the largest deviation from the plan line (every vertex costs a face in 3D).
